name: One match with its replay

input.query: SELECT mt.replay_key, json_build_object(  'id', mt.id, 'game', g.slug, 'seed', mt.seed, 'preset', mt.preset,  'reason', mt.reason, 'played_at', mt.played_at,  'players', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(       'seat', s.ord - 1, 'model_id', s.model_id, 'owner', u.handle,       'model_version', md.version, 'rank', s.rank, 'score', s.score)       ORDER BY s.ord), '[]'::json)     FROM unnest(mt.model_ids, mt.ranks, mt.scores)          WITH ORDINALITY AS s(model_id, rank, score, ord)     LEFT JOIN models md ON md.id = s.model_id     LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = md.owner_id))::text AS body FROM matches mt JOIN games g ON g.id = mt.game_id WHERE mt.id = ($1)::uuid

description: The body column is cast to text and parsed back by a parse_json task: Orion's db_read goes through sqlx's Any driver, which cannot decode the Postgres json/jsonb type and fails the task outright. Casting keeps response construction in SQL -- see README 'Postgres builds the response JSON' -- at the cost of one extra task.
